extension_rationale.increments: Transparent native question resolutions, not MCID, assay SD or empirical calibration. No named-study scores used to choose them.
extension_rationale.nesting: Adding native questions changes joint targets and within-panel weights. This is a separately named non-nested pilot, not native31 AB1 or its AB2 child.
extension_rationale.omitted_unqualified: Serum Luminex IL1B, p400HR xLeu, glycan structures and flow gates remain inventory candidates until exact native units/feature definitions qualify; acquired does not mean absent.
extension_rationale.weight_policy: Five domain budgets and every existing panel parent budget retained; each expanded panel redistributes its existing native/joint workload mass. No new global bonus. All comparisons use identical full native36 task catalogue.

controlled_effects.criterion: Joint native effect-vector SE<=0.5 reference scales; randomized assignment, consistency and followup gates.
controlled_effects.estimand: At fixed registered endpoint, assigned effect averaged equally over two prespecified baseline strata in internal site; nuisance trajectories retained.

external_replication.criterion: Joint replication-difference SE<=0.5 reference scales; precision, not equality/clinical success or universal transport.
external_replication.estimand: Difference between internal and independent external-site assigned endpoint effects, each equal-stratum standardized.

individual_state.criterion: Worst direction in reference-scaled baseline covariance <=0.75^2, not only marginal variances.
individual_state.estimand: Per-person baseline vector of named native observables, without population shrinkage. Participant-weighted fraction attaining bundle, with deep-subset distribution preserved.

personalized_response.criterion: Joint native interaction-vector SE<=0.5 reference scales, four-cell overlap through design rank.
personalized_response.estimand: Difference in assigned endpoint effects between two prespecified baseline strata; no individual causal-effect ground truth.

population_variation.criterion: Every identified covariance functional at SE<=0.5 reference-scale-products, with joint worst-direction criterion. Fixed biological-stratum nuisance means removed across acquisition patterns by restricted Gaussian quadratic moments. Exact covariance at the declared challenge point; not uniformly over untested distributions.
population_variation.estimand: Common within-biological-stratum residual baseline covariance of native quantities, site×arm×prespecifiedmodifier mean trajectories removed using one shared nuisance space across all acquisition patterns. Not total marginal variation across strata.

trajectories.criterion: Worst direction of joint change/curvature covariance <=0.75^2, with participant-weighted attainment.
trajectories.estimand: Per-person endpoint-minus-baseline and midpoint departure from endpoint interpolation for each native quantity at fixed registered horizon.

generative_model.all_direction: Joint worst generalized variance ratio, alongside native functional tasks. Task attainment is binary at ratio<=1; continuous adequacy=min(1,1/ratio) retains source and structural support gates but does not reinterpret a precision failure as structural absence.
generative_model.coordinate_standardization: Fixed native reference scale a_j, never source sample SD. Native y=D x. H selects registered native reading and actual time basis.
generative_model.known_challenge_covariance: B and R are benchmark conditions, not extracted/calibrated biological facts. They must be estimated and validated to support realized precision claims.
generative_model.measurement_error: q*(0.75 I+0.25 Z ZT), where Z indexes coordinate-specific session; q=1 or2 coherent across all panels.
generative_model.population_covariance_estimator: Fixed biological strata site×arm×modifier share mean trajectory X across acquisition patterns. P=W−WX(XT W X)^+XTW. qk=.5[yT P Dk P y−tr(PDk)]; Ikl=.5tr(PDkP Dl). At challengeV0, P V0 P=P, PX=0, E(q)=I(theta−theta0) and Cov(q)=I. theta_hat=theta0+I^-1q is unbiased in affine covariance model and has exactcovarianceI^-1 atV0. Patternaggregate traceformula avoids person×person matrices. No acquisition-specific nuisance means.
generative_model.random_coefficients: Across independent persons, nodal covariance B=C tensor K, C=.75I+.25ones. K(t,s)=4+sum over ell in {7,30,365} [exp(-abs(t-s)/ell)-exp(-t/ell)-exp(-s/ell)+1]. Persistent baseline plus independent baseline-centered OU components. These are normative benchmark conditions, not fitted biology.
generative_model.time_basis: Piecewise-linear basis on fixed absolute-day nodes; current tasks use observations within0..365. Baseline state and population covariance use actual day0 only. Endpoint effect families use actual0 and exact registered endpoint only. Post365 observations remain bound to input but explicitly unused, never warped.
generative_model.trajectory: Native scaled per-person nodal vector at days0,3.5,7,15,30,45,90,182.5,365; observations linearly interpolate adjacent fixed nodes. No study-relative rescaling. Causal estimands use free baseline/endpoint mean parameters at each horizon, randomized treatment absent from baseline, and their common nodal person covariance.

additional_required_inputs: Prespecified genotype stratum definition and enrolled support
genomic_context_extension.estimand: Treatment-by-prespecified carrier status interaction on named downstream native observables, not genotype treatment response
genomic_context_extension.implementation_status: Not implemented in Gaussian prototype; ordinary modifier labels do not establish genotype qualification.
genomic_context_extension.reference_variant: rs7903146 TCF7L2 C>T, coordinate/build and allele harmonization required

known_scope_limits: Sequence/genotype is immutable context: genotype quality and variant-stratified response require a separate finite categorical/reference-variant extension; no fabricated Gaussian state credit. This remains an explicit missing task family rather than an implied absence of genomic value.
No full nonlinear mechanistic recovery, ex vivo perturbation, spatial tissue map, adaptive treatment regime, causal transport to unobserved populations, or all biological information claim.

Fixed finite nodal contrasts cannot establish arbitrary trajectory reconstruction; unsampled paths and misspecification remain open. Causal endpoint families deliberately omit off-endpoint readings rather than assume a treatment-response curve.
An identical conditional score for two panels with the same native measurement geometry is deliberate common-noise capability, not proof equal real assay reliability.

not_equivalent: Serum vs plasma without qualified bridge
WGBS read fraction vs EPIC beta
Cognitive performance vs direct neural acquisition
Pathway gene abundance vs metabolic flux
measurement_equivalence_policy.planned: A source-supported alternative quantitative assay for the same native quantity, specimen compartment and unit may map under an explicitly declared common-unbiased-measurement challenge. Keep actual method and source-qualified compatibility decision.
measurement_equivalence_policy.realized: Conditional mapping does not establish equal bias/noise or actual calibration; empirical claims require applicable QC/calibration.

normative_sensitivity.interpretation: Multiply every SElimit coherently; frozen sensitivity, not choose winning factor after ranks. Defaultstate .75 times fixednativeincrement means one noisyreadingwithunitvariance fails; factor1.5passes it. Neither number is biologicaltruth.
normative_sensitivity.needed_before_adoption: Comparative decision rationale and calibrated achievable resolutions across assay-native tasks, not study-ranking tuning.

reference_conventions: Native scales inherited as draft round biological increments, no clinical importance/calibration claim; molecular panel breadth prevents a routine fasting blood test from impersonating tissue/cellular/microbial depth.
registry_assessment: Expanded36nativecoordinates/14panels is a bounded candidate catalogue, not representative coverage of all multiomics. Native platform readouts and physiological quantities are different task frames. A single gene/CpG does not establish transcriptome/methylome depth. Catalogue and weights require independent biological coverage adjudication before main-benchmark adoption.

source_correction.meaning: Different native observable; no alias, conversion, old-result relabeling or empirical validation transfer.

status: Separately named native36 pilot reference; non-nested with native31 AB1/AB2

temporal_workload.beyond_window: Finite nonnegative actual times are accepted and bound. Current<=365day tasks ignore later events and report their pattern-event count. Longer-horizon child workload is not implemented or implied; adding it must preserve parent tasks, models and criteria.
temporal_workload.integration: Main compiler default coherent_absolute_v1 emits canonical finite-task components for all four horizons, preserving each panel and biological-domain total budget.
temporal_workload.rationale: Acute, recovery, intermediate and annual followup are separate finite questions; horizons are conventions, not universal biological transition times.

weighting: Six separate capability percentages, equal five domain budgets, equal panel budgets within domains. Each panel devotes half its mass to fixed native targets and half to joint all-direction resolution; singleton usesfullmass. Perperson families integrate overselectedcohort and retainacquisitiongroupdistribution. Nooverallscalar.
